messages.author: Ch Bilal
messages.body:
HI Amber Users,
I am performing system preparation of a protein-ligand complex (a protein of 1321aa) using AMBER20. The problem is that ligand gets broken during system preparation. I am attaching the system preparation commands here. Could you please help me to find out what is the problem?
Thank you,

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:

>system preparation. I am attaching the system preparation commands

Can you explain more about what you mean when you say "the ligand gets
broken"? Have you run a simulation with just the ligand, and no protein?
....dac
